newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Marsford bids A$0.70/shr for Allied.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Marsford bids A$0.70/shr for Allied.

text.p: Unlisted Marsford Investments said on Monday it would offer 70 cents per share for Allied Queensland Coalfields Ltd, topping an earlier offer from Centennial Coal Co Ltd of 60 cents per share.
The offer, which values Allied at A$19.39 million, is on-market through Morgan Stockbroking and runs from October 8 until November 8.
Marsford said it currently held 4.92 million Allied shares or about 17.8 percent of its issued capital.
Centennial Coal said on launching its bid on September 19 that it held 9.9 percent of Allied's shares.
The key to success for either bid is the 43.4 percent of Allied held by Crusader Ltd.
Crusader said last week that it would accept Centennial Coal's offer in the absence of a higher one.
By 11.00 a.m. (0100 GMT), Allied shares were four cents higher at 70 cents on turnover of 4.96 million shares.
